misses.description: the float-selection rule did not anticipate a float flagged 2 on every level, so the decisive test had nothing to compute; a second float was chosen post hoc (A2)
the prereg assumed the database's MLD in dbar and its temperature in situ; the file holds TEOS-10 depths and Conservative Temperature, and its attributes never say so
the database holds 1,385,119 valid rows against the abstract's 'nearly 1,250,000' (possibly a later file than the paper's own processing)
the 2017 database's density-threshold rule is not identified: five density definitions give at most 1 of 259 exact, and the rule is unpublished

the derived database file fails 10 of 12 format checks (no Conventions attribute, non-CF standard names, typed range mismatches, status meaning in units, a MATLAB datenum date, TEOS-10 quantities under EOS-80-era units)
cycles 227 and 228 of float 19019 compute normally but have no database row, for no visible reason
